lead: A second `#[cfg(test)]` item in an `nvs-stdlib` module fails a test in another file, about a scan rather than your item.
body: `nvs_stdlib_reaches_the_os_only_through_the_gate` reads each module to its first `#[cfg(test)]` and refuses a second, so a test-only helper beside the state it reads turns the crate red elsewhere. Put every test-only item in the module's `mod tests`, reaching private state through `super::`.
